title: satureja serpyllifolia
intro: Satureja serpyllifolia, commonly known as the Creeping Thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its culinary, medicinal, and ornamental uses. Creeping Thyme has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, such as indigestion and nausea, due to its carminative and anti-inflammatory properties. Its health benefits include soothing the digestive system, relieving stress, and promoting healthy skin; its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are derived from bioactive constituents like thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid.
